source_state: uncommitted native pooled/indexed attention workspace bounds and pooled-mask normalization
behavior: Pooled attention composes native bank concatenation, broadcast-mask normalization, and selected fused/fallback SDPA facts. Indexed attention composes two direct selected gathers, four batch_tensordot contractions, score masks, shared sink softmax and context addition.

Einsum bounds include input/output transpose-reshape copies around the ordinary Metal matmul cast/layout/split-product bounds. Broadcast source banks and indices remain views; direct GatherAxis facts charge selected outputs without full-bank replication.

Pooled-position selection includes explicit F32 scoring, nonnegative clamp, head weighting and reduction, optional eligibility and native argpartition sort ping-pong/partition buffers. A selected tail retains the complete U32 index backing, checked against actual native allocation identity/capacity.

Native pooled masks accept broadcast-compatible batch/head/query shapes, convert Boolean eligibility to zero/negative-infinity when mixed with additive masks, use zero for an absent additive mask, and cast the joined additive mask to the promoted attention dtype.
Empty pooled-position history produces empty U32 output with bounded scalar backing.

648 native configurations cover F32/F16/BF16, contiguous/strided inputs, empty local or pooled history, 4097-position pooled banks, masks and sinks. Active Metal allocator peaks fit cold bounds. Attention outputs match independent scalar host softmax/dot equations; selected indices are unique and meet independently computed top-k thresholds; mask gathers match exact indexing.

Routed DeepSeek execution, pooling prompt-cache restoration, and native initial/cached prepared-workspace inspection pass. Complete cached model quotes still retain explicit unknown costs for other required operators.

tolerances.input_reference: native inputs converted to F32 after measurement, preserving their actual rounding

limits: This does not complete public request admission or full-family/path coverage. Relative attention, multi-axis rotary, grouped/native routing and addressable expert scheduling still have missing prices or composition, alongside materialization/transfers, paging, TP/PP, media, observations, speculation and independent copies.

Native bounds cover active managed payload storage through completion, not allocator cache, driver/JIT, total process or system memory. No new process-memory or released-checkpoint experiment was run.

The 36-test workspace suite leaves 31 separately controlled allocator benchmarks ignored; the new pooled benchmark was explicitly run in the focused suite. Two cold pooled tests occur in both commands, hence 42 unique tests rather than 44.
An initial test build used an incorrect stride-helper import; a subsequent native run exposed additive-mask precision incompatibility. The recorded final commands passed after both fixes.
Existing large-unwind linker and unused internal quote/helper warnings remain in logs.
